templates.name: Fraction
templates.description: Typesets a numerator above a denominator separated by a horizontal bar at the current size.

templates.name: Display-style fraction
templates.description: Typesets a fraction in display style so that the numerator and denominator stay large in inline math.

templates.name: Text-style fraction
templates.description: Typesets a fraction in text style so that a nested fraction stays compact in display math.

templates.name: Continued fraction
templates.description: Typesets a continued fraction, laying out each nested level in display style so that it stays readable.

slots.description: denominator, which may itself be a continued fraction

templates.name: Binomial coefficient
templates.description: Typesets a binomial coefficient as a stacked pair of entries inside parentheses.

slots.description: top entry, usually the total number n
bottom entry, usually the number chosen k

templates.name: Display-style binomial coefficient
templates.description: Typesets a binomial coefficient in display style so that the stacked entries stay large in inline math.

slots.description: top entry, usually the total number n
bottom entry, usually the number chosen k

templates.name: Text-style binomial coefficient
templates.description: Typesets a compact binomial coefficient for use inside running text.

slots.description: top entry, usually the total number n
bottom entry, usually the number chosen k

templates.name: Square root
templates.description: Typesets the square root of a radicand.

templates.name: Nth root
templates.description: Typesets an nth root with the index in square brackets in front of a required radicand.

templates.name: Overline
templates.description: Draws a horizontal line over the whole expression.

templates.name: Underline
templates.description: Draws a horizontal line under the content and works in both text and math mode.

templates.name: Bar accent
templates.description: Places a short bar accent over a single symbol, as used for a mean or a complex conjugate.

templates.name: Overbrace with annotation
templates.description: Draws a horizontal brace above an expression and sets the annotation above the brace.

templates.name: Underbrace with subscript annotation
templates.description: Draws a horizontal brace below an expression and sets the annotation below the brace as a subscript.

slots.description: annotation set below the brace as a subscript

templates.name: Braces above and below
templates.description: Brackets one expression from both sides with an annotation above the outer brace and one below the inner brace.

slots.description: annotation set below the inner brace
annotation set above the outer brace

templates.name: Overset
templates.description: Places a symbol or annotation directly above an arbitrary base expression.

slots.description: base expression that the annotation sits on

templates.name: Underset
templates.description: Places a symbol or annotation directly below an arbitrary base expression.

slots.description: base expression that the annotation sits under

templates.name: Stackrel
templates.description: Stacks a symbol above a relation using only commands of the LaTeX kernel.

slots.description: relation symbol that the annotation sits on

templates.name: Hat accent
templates.description: Places a circumflex accent over a symbol, as used for an estimator or a unit vector.

templates.name: Wide hat accent
templates.description: Places a circumflex accent that stretches over a multi-character expression.

slots.description: expression that the wide hat spans

templates.name: Tilde accent
templates.description: Places a tilde accent over a symbol.

templates.name: Wide tilde accent
templates.description: Places a tilde accent that stretches over a multi-character expression.

slots.description: expression that the wide tilde spans

templates.name: Vector arrow
templates.description: Places a small right arrow over a symbol to denote a vector.

slots.description: symbol that receives the vector arrow

templates.name: Dot accent
templates.description: Places a single dot over a symbol, as used for a first derivative with respect to time.

templates.name: Double dot accent
templates.description: Places two dots over a symbol, as used for a second derivative with respect to time.

slots.description: symbol that receives the two dots

templates.name: Breve accent
templates.description: Places a breve accent over a symbol.

templates.name: Check accent
templates.description: Places a caron or check accent over a symbol.

templates.name: Acute accent
templates.description: Places an acute accent over a symbol.

slots.description: symbol that receives the acute accent

templates.name: Grave accent
templates.description: Places a grave accent over a symbol.

slots.description: symbol that receives the grave accent

templates.name: Ring accent
templates.description: Places a small circle over a symbol.

templates.name: Parentheses
templates.description: Delimits an expression with parentheses that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Square brackets
templates.description: Delimits an expression with square brackets that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Braces
templates.description: Delimits an expression with curly braces that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Angle brackets
templates.description: Delimits an expression with angle brackets that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Vertical bars
templates.description: Delimits an expression with single vertical bars that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Double vertical bars
templates.description: Delimits an expression with double vertical bars that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Floor
templates.description: Rounds an expression down inside floor brackets that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Ceiling
templates.description: Rounds an expression up inside ceiling brackets that grow to fit the content.

templates.name: Absolute value
templates.description: Delimits the absolute value of an expression with fixed-size vertical bars.

slots.description: expression whose absolute value is taken

templates.name: Norm
templates.description: Delimits the norm of an expression with fixed-size double vertical bars.

templates.name: Evaluation bar
templates.description: Typesets an expression followed by a vertical bar that carries the point at which the expression is evaluated.

slots.description: point of evaluation, for example x=0

templates.name: Matrix
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a two-by-two grid without delimiters.

templates.name: Parenthesised matrix
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a two-by-two grid enclosed in parentheses.

templates.name: Bracketed matrix
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a two-by-two grid enclosed in square brackets.

templates.name: Matrix with vertical bars
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a two-by-two grid enclosed in vertical bars, as used for determinants.

templates.name: Small matrix
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a compact two-by-two grid sized for use inside a line of text.

templates.name: Cases
templates.description: Lists two labelled cases inside a left brace.

slots.description: value or expression of the first case
value or expression of the second case

templates.name: Array
templates.description: Arranges four entries in a two-by-two array whose two columns are centred.

templates.name: Aligned equations
templates.description: Aligns two equation lines on the ampersand markers for use inside another math environment.

slots.description: left-hand side of the first line
right-hand side of the first line
left-hand side of the second line
right-hand side of the second line

templates.name: Align environment
templates.description: Displays two numbered equation lines aligned on the ampersand markers.

slots.description: left-hand side of the first line
right-hand side of the first line
left-hand side of the second line
right-hand side of the second line

templates.name: Align environment, unnumbered
templates.description: Displays two unnumbered equation lines aligned on the ampersand markers.

slots.description: left-hand side of the first line
right-hand side of the first line
left-hand side of the second line
right-hand side of the second line

templates.name: Gather environment
templates.description: Centres two numbered display lines without aligning them.

templates.name: Gather environment, unnumbered
templates.description: Centres two unnumbered display lines without aligning them.

templates.name: Equation environment
templates.description: Displays a single numbered equation on a line of its own.

templates.name: Substack
templates.description: Stacks two lines of a subscript or limit expression vertically.

templates.name: Boxed aligned equations
templates.description: Displays two aligned equation lines together inside a single frame.

slots.description: left-hand side of the first line
right-hand side of the first line
left-hand side of the second line
right-hand side of the second line

templates.name: Text in math
templates.description: Sets ordinary text, keeping spaces and word shapes, inside a math expression.

slots.description: literal text to set in the current text font

templates.name: Text superscript
templates.description: Raises text as a superscript in text mode, as in the ending of an ordinal number.

templates.name: Text subscript
templates.description: Lowers text as a subscript in text mode, as in a chemical formula.

templates.name: Operator name
templates.description: Typesets a multi-letter function name in upright roman with operator spacing.

slots.description: function name such as rank or diag

templates.name: Upright Roman
templates.description: Sets math content in the upright roman font.

slots.description: content to be set in upright roman

templates.name: Blackboard bold
templates.description: Sets a letter in blackboard bold, the usual font for number sets.

slots.description: letter or word to be set in blackboard bold

templates.name: Bold upright
templates.description: Sets math content in bold upright roman.

slots.description: content to be set in bold upright roman

templates.name: Calligraphic
templates.description: Sets a letter in the calligraphic script font.

slots.description: letter or word to be set in the calligraphic font

templates.name: Fraktur
templates.description: Sets a letter in the Fraktur font.

slots.description: letter or word to be set in the Fraktur font

templates.name: Bold math symbol
templates.description: Makes a symbol or expression bold while keeping its math font shape.

slots.description: symbol or expression to be made bold

templates.name: Bold math with bm
templates.description: Makes a symbol or expression bold with the bm package, which also covers Greek letters and accents.

slots.description: symbol or expression to be made bold

templates.name: Boxed formula
templates.description: Draws a frame around a formula.

slots.description: formula or expression to be framed

templates.name: Cancellation
templates.description: Strikes a diagonal line through an expression to show that it cancels.

templates.name: Colour in math
templates.description: Colours part of a formula without changing the rest of the math.

slots.description: colour name such as red or blue

templates.name: Labelled right arrow
templates.description: Draws a right arrow that stretches to fit a label placed above it.

templates.name: Labelled left arrow
templates.description: Draws a left arrow that stretches to fit a label placed above it.

templates.name: Labelled two-headed arrow
templates.description: Draws a two-headed arrow that stretches to fit a label placed above it.

templates.name: Right arrow with a label below
templates.description: Draws a right arrow with an optional label below it and a required label above it.

slots.description: optional label placed below the arrow

templates.name: Left prescripts
templates.description: Places a superscript and a subscript to the left of a symbol, as used for isotopes and tensor indices.

slots.description: base symbol that carries the prescripts

templates.name: Modulo annotation
templates.description: Appends a parenthesised modulo annotation to a congruence.

templates.name: Modulo operator
templates.description: Typesets two operands joined by the binary modulo operator, which is spaced like a relation.
